candidates.title: machine-solidity-step v0.17.0-test1 regenerated from audit/prt2 does not compile: UArchStep.sol references TLB_NUM_SETS, which neither the constants template nor generate_EmulatorConstants.lua defines
candidates.location: src/uarch-step.cpp (set_index >= TLB_NUM_SETS check, around line 890); machine-solidity-step generate-* targets, EmulatorConstants template
candidates.description: Observed by the Prepare agent, not by a hunter. Pure regeneration with the project's generate-* targets against audit/prt2 yields a UArchStep.sol with 'Undeclared identifier TLB_NUM_SETS'. A workaround variant adding 'uint64 constant TLB_NUM_SETS = 3' builds; with it, replay tests 56/56 pass; test-prod 14/15 (testCmMarchId expects 22, got 23); test-mock 3/5 (testHaltEcallReachesCycleLimit, testStepEarlyReturn expect overflow to win over halt, which this branch reversed). See bugs/harness/work/solidity-step/{build-status,results,diff-summary,failures}.txt.
candidates.rule_quotes: R13: 'The uarch program, its pristine hash, and the verifier code that a deployment fixes on-chain must be reproducibly buildable from audited source.'
